snippet.title: DUCKSIDE - Console Announcement Trailer | Wishlist Now | tinyBuild Connect 2025
snippet.description:
XBOX Series X|S - https://www.microsoft.com/store/productid/9n7zd84gh1nk
Playstation 5 - https://store.playstation.com/concept/10013703

DUCKSIDE is landing on PlayStation5 and XBOX Series X|S this August!

Get ready to ruffle some feathers and dive into a persistent world survival game with PVP, PVE, crafting, base building and hat-wearing ducks, wielding weapons.
